deadline.value: The mechanical engineering PhD page gives no application deadline.

supervisor.value: Applicants are admitted based on research interests and openings in the research group, so a group match comes before admission.
supervisor.quote: All applicants are admitted based on their research interests and openings in the research group

funding.value: The page does not describe funding for PhD students.

entry_route.value: A four-year B.S. in mechanical engineering or a closely related field; the page names no master's route.
entry_route.quote: A four-year B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering or closely related engineering and science disciplines

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Applications go through https://gradapply.slu.edu/apply/, which could not be fetched. The Aerospace Engineering PhD (catalog aerospace-mechanical/aerospace-engineering-phd) has the same admission rules, from the same department.
name: Mechanical Engineering PhD (Aerospace Engineering PhD on its own page)
